messages:
taylor: Heads-up — running a 6h loadtest on dev-sandbox Friday (23:00 UTC). Can someone confirm we have standby GPU quota (eu-west1) for h100s or a fallback plan?

maria: pinging vendor now. is this for Dedicated pool or ephemeral demo slots?

taylor: Dedicated, but low-throughput canary first — want to keep latency SLOs. If Dedicated not possible, fallback to a100 burst is fine.

jon: FYI PR #4125 updates the pool config (autoscale min=2 -> 4). If quota isn't there the PR will fail smoke. cc @maria

maria: got vendor on thread, they said "checking inventory, ETA ~48h for extra h100s". I'll confirm cost delta.

remy: finance, any chance to lift the billing hold for this reserve? we only need a small standby bump for 24h.

finance: quick answer — we can approve one-off dev spend if procurement signs off. need ticket with expected cost.

maria: procurement-bot just posted an allocation request: `ALLOC-7921` — vendor asking for PO confirmation.

procurement-bot: allocation request ALLOC-7921 created, awaiting PO from finance and signature. ETA vendor confirm: 2 business days.

jon: if vendor ETA is 48h we won't make Friday midnight. Two options: 1) run reduced-load test on a100, 2) postpone till monday after confirm. Which do we prefer?

remy: lean a100 reduced-load for Friday to validate flow; then full h100 test monday. less risky for prod.

maria: agreed. I'll patch PR #4125 to set min=2 for the Friday run and add a comment linking ALLOC-7921.

jon: thanks. tagging reviewers for quick lgtm: @taylor @remy. I can carve ephemeral a100 slice if needed — will post command.

jon: command to request ephemeral slice (if needed):
```
./alloc-cli request --region eu-west1 --sku a100 --count 4 --ttl 6h --reason "dev-sandbox loadtest"
```

Taylor: perfect. maria, please confirm once vendor flips to confirmed or if finance needs anything else. otherwise we'll proceed with the a100 fallback Friday. :thumbsup:

maria: will do — updating ALLOC-7921 with finance ticket ref and PR link now.

procurement-bot: ALLOC-7921 status updated -> pending-finance.

remy: thanks team — marking oncall for Friday window in calendar.

jon: small followup — can someone add a note to the runbook about latency expected on a100 vs h100? saves confusion during test.

Taylor: adding note now. good catch.
